explain.say: Look up at a traffic light hanging over a busy road in Lagos or Mumbai. It hangs perfectly still from two cables. Still means equilibrium, a state where all the forces cancel out. Let us find how hard each cable pulls on this 20 kilogram light.

faq.q: What are the conditions for equilibrium?
faq.a: For a particle, the forces in every direction add to zero. For a rigid body in a plane, the forces in x and y add to zero and the moments about any point add to zero too: three equations.
asks: what does equilibrium mean in statics

faq.q: Why are cable tensions bigger when the cables are flatter?
faq.a: Only the vertical part of each tension holds up the weight. A flatter cable has a smaller sine of its angle, so the tension must grow to give the same upward part.
asks: why do flat cables have high tension

faq.q: What is the difference between a particle and a rigid body?
faq.a: A particle is a model where all forces pass through one point, so it cannot rotate. A rigid body has size, so forces at different points can turn it, and moments must balance too.

faq.q: How do I find support reactions on a beam?
faq.a: Take moments about one support to find the other reaction, then add up the vertical forces to find the first. Check by taking moments about a different point.
A body with forces at only two points. For equilibrium the two forces must be equal, opposite and along the line joining the points, like a truss bar or a link.

facts: A rigid body in a plane has three independent equilibrium equations: two force sums and one moment sum.
A pin support can push in any direction in the plane; a roller pushes only at right angles to its surface.

quiz.say: A 6 metre beam on two end supports carries 12 kilonewtons at 2 metres from the left end. What is the right-hand reaction?
quiz.show: A 6 m beam on end supports carries 12 kN at 2 m from the left. Right reaction?
quiz.why: Moments about the left support: R × 6 = 12 × 2, so R = 4 kN.

wrong.1: That is the left reaction, which is nearer the load.
wrong.2: Splitting equally only works when the load is in the middle.

quiz.say: How many independent equilibrium equations does a rigid body in a plane have?
quiz.show: Independent equilibrium equations for a 2D rigid body?
quiz.why: Sum of x forces, sum of y forces and sum of moments: three.

wrong.0: Two is enough for a particle, which cannot rotate.
wrong.2: Six is for a rigid body in three dimensions.
